why_r2_rejected.mechanism: r2 moves libttmplayer into the android-native namespace (NATIVE_TARGETS) so its NDK-C++ chain resolves against the APK libc++. libttmplayer DT_NEEDED libmffmpeg.so is then resolved by musl's by-NAME path (find_library_by_name -> load_library, oh61 dynlink e50b30f2 L2408/L2552). That path never runs RouteB SanitizeInitArray, which fires only on ART's explicit System.loadLibrary entry (link_stubs_arm64.cc 87a2e823 L552-559). The APK libmffmpeg.so (fecf91e1) has a single INIT_ARRAY slot at vaddr 0x45c168 whose file value is 0 with zero relocations targeting it (object-facts.txt). musl do_init_fini has no null guard (e50b30f2 L3446-3457: `while (n--) ((void(*)(void))*fn++)();`) -> it would call address 0: a PREDICTED crash (static), not an observed one -- in the observed r2 run the libvcbasekit ns0 relocation LOAD-FAIL fired first and masked it. Same outcome whether libmffmpeg is a target (ART loads it, SanitizeInitArray writes the dotted sibling, the by-name NEEDED misses the dotted shortname and reloads the original) or ns0 (previously masked by the libvcbasekit relocation failure).
